3. In the said Ordinance,
after subsection (2) of section 17, the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:‑---
"(3) Every
nomination shall be made by a separate nomination paper in the prescribed form
on solemn affirmation made and signed by the candidate, accompany‑‑
(i) a declaration that he has
consented to the nomination and that he fulfils the qualifications and is not
subject to any of the disqualifications being elected as a member;
(ii) a declaration that no loan,
obtained from Government any bank, financial institution, cooperative society
or corporate body in his own name or in the name of his spouse or dependent
children or dependent parents or any business concern mainly owned by the
aforesaid, remains unpaid for more than one year from due date;
(iii) a declaration that no loan,
other than a loan written off under the orders of the Government because of any
natural calamity, obtained by him, his spouse or dependent children or
dependent parents or any business concern mainly owned by the aforesaid from
any bank, financial institution, cooperative society or corporate body was
written off;
(iv) a declaration that he, his
spouse or dependent children or dependent parents or a business concern mainly
owned by the aforesaid have not made any default in payment of taxes for over
six months;
(v) a declaration that he, his
spouse or dependent children or dependent parents or a business concern mainly
owned by the aforesaid have not made any default in payment of Government dues
and utility expenses including telephone, electricity, gas and water charges,
for over six months;
(vi) a statement specifying, his
educational qualifications, occupation National Identity Card Number, National
Tax Number, if any and date of birth/age;
(vii) a statement of assets and
liabilities of his own, spouse and dependents on the prescribed form as on the
preceding thirtieth day of June;
(viii) a statement specifying
income‑tax, wealth tax paid by him during last 3 assessment years and
where applicable, land revenue paid by him during the last two financial years;
(ix) an assurance that he shall
abide by the Code of Conduct issued by the Election Authority;
Explanation.‑‑For
the purpose of this section the expression‑‑
(a) "loan" shall mean
the loan, advance credit or finance obtained or written off on or after the
31st day of December, 1985;
(b) "mainly owned" shall mean holding of controlling or
majority interest in a business concern;
(c) "taxes" includes
all taxes levied by Federal, Provincial or Local authorities;
(d) "Government dues"
includes rent charges of rest house" or lodges owned by the Federal
Government, Provincial Government, Local authorities or Corporations
established or controlled by such Government."

Insertion of new section 18-A in Ordinance II of 1980

No. LEGIS.2‑30/LAW/75‑IX,
dated 17‑8‑1998.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 16th August, 1998, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑----
4. Insertion of new section 18‑A
in Ordinance II of 1980.‑In the said Ordinance after section 18, the
following new sections shall be added namely:‑‑
"18‑A.‑‑Assistance
to Election Authority.‑‑It shall be the duty of all the executive
authorities in the Federation, in the Province and all Local authorities under
the administrative control of Federation and Province to assist tile Election
Authority in the performance of its functions as may be required of them by the
Election Authority or its member or Officer authorised by the Election
Authority.
18‑B.‑‑Suspension
of Officer.‑‑(1) The Election Authority may at any time, for
reasons to be recorded in writing, suspend any officer performing the functions
of the Returning Officers, Assistant Returning Officers, Presiding Officer,
Assistant Presiding Officer, Polling Officer, Delimitation Officer, Assistant
Delimitation Officer or any other public functionary assisting such Officer or
any member of the Police force or other law enforcing agency who obstruct or
pretence or attempts to obstruct or prevent the conduct of fair and impartial
polls or influence or attempts to interfere viz. an elector when he records his
vote or influence in any manner the polling staff or an elector or does any
other act calculated to influence the result of an elector and Made such
arrangements as it may consider necessary for the performance of the functions
of the officer so suspended.
(2) Where the
Election Authority proceeds against any person under subsection (1), it shall
refer the matter to the appropriate authority for taking disciplinary action
against such person.
18‑C.‑‑Contempt
of Election Authority.‑‑Any proceedings before the Election
Authority shall be deemed to be a judicial proceedings within the meaning of
section 228 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860, and the Election Authority shall
be deemed to be a Court within the meaning of sectiorts 476 and 480 of the
Criminal Procedure Code, 1898.

Substitution of section 20 of Ordinance II of 1980

No. LEGIS.2‑30/LAW/75‑IX,
dated 17‑8‑1998.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 16th August, 1998, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑----
5. Substitution of section 20
of Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the said Ordinance, for section
20, the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"20.
Qualification of candidates and members.‑‑A person, shall be
qualified to be a candidate and a member of the Local Council if‑‑
(a) he is a citizen of Pakistan;
(b) he is not less than twenty‑one
years of age and is enrolled as a voter in any electoral roll of any local area
within the limits of Local Council in which the seat falls;
(c) he is of good character and
is not commonly known as one who violates Islamic Injunction;
(d) he has adequate knowledge of
Islamic teachings and practices obligatory duties prescribed by Islam as well
as abstains from major sins;
(e) he is sagacious, righteous,
non‑profligate, honest, ameen and pays his debts and taxes specified in
subsection (3) of section 17 of the Ordinance;
(t) he has not been convicted for
a crime involving moral turpitude or for giving false evidence, and
(g) he has not, after the
establishment of Pakistan, worked against the integrity of the country or
opposed the ideology of Pakistan:
Provided that the
disqualification s specified in clauses (c) and (d) shall not apply to a person
who is a non‑Muslim, but such a person shall have good moral reputation.

Substitution of section 21 of Ordinance II of 1980

GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE II OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th August, 1998]
No. LEGIS.2‑30/LAW/75‑IX,
dated 17‑8‑1998.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 16th August, 1998, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑----
6. Substitution of section 21
of Ordinance II of 1980.‑In the said Ordinance, for section 21, the
following shall by substituted:‑‑
"21.‑‑Disqualification
of candidates and members.‑‑(1) A person shall be disqualified from
being elected as, and from being, a member of a Local Council, if‑‑
(a) he ceases to be a citizen of
Pakistan or acquires the citizenship of foreign State, or
(b) he is an undischarged
insolvent, or
(c) he is of unsound mind and has
been so declared by a competent Court, or
(d) he is a wholetime salaried
official of the Federal Government or a Provincial Government or of a public or
statutory Corporation, a Local Council or other local Authority; or
(e) has been on conviction for an
offence involving moral turpitude, sentenced
to imprisonment for a term of not less than six months;
Explanation.‑‑Moral
turpitude means anything that injures the moral fibre of a person and lowers
him down in moral values‑‑
(f) he has been dismissed from
the service of Federal Government or a Provincial Government or of public or
statutory corporation on the ground of misconduct, unless a period of two years
has not elapsed since his dismissal, or
(g) he has in the service of
Federal Government or Provincial Government or of any statutory body or anybody
which is owned or controlled by the Government or in which the Government has a
controlling share or interest, unless a period of one year has not elapsed
since he ceased to be in such service, or
(h) he is found guilty of a
corrupt or illegal practice under any law for the time being in force, unless a
period of two years has elapsed from the date on which that order takes effect,
or
(i) he, whether by himself or by
any person or body or persons in trust for him or for his benefit or on his
account or as a member of a Hindu undivided family has any share or interest in
a contract, not being a contract between a cooperative society and Government,
for the supply of goods to, or for the execution of any contract or for the
performance of any service undertaken by Government, or
(j) he has been removed or
compulsorily retired from the service of Federal Government, Provincial
Government or of a public or statutory corporation, on the ground of misconduct
unless a period of two years has not elapsed since his removal or compulsory
retirement; or
(k) he is a retired servant of
the Federal Government or the Provincial Government or of a public or statutory
corporation, a Local Council or other local Authority unless one year has
elapsed from the date of such retirement; or
(1) he is under contract for work
to be done or goods to be supplied to the Local Council concerned or has
otherwise any pecuniary interest in its affairs; or
(m) he is disqualified from the
membership of any elective body under any law for the time being in force; and
(n) he has been or is engaged
directly or indirectly in subversive or anti‑State activities or
propagating any opinion or acting in any manner prejudicial to the ideology of
Pakistan or the sovereignty, integrity or security of Pakistan.
Explanation.‑‑Anti‑State
activities shall include instigation to students, labour or any other section of
people with a view to promote lawlessness or disorder.
(2) No order passed under
subsection (1) shall be called in question in any Court.
